description: Structured record for one official IMD warning (operational input). One record per warning; district-level output rows are derived from `districts`. These records are NOT model features and must never be joined into feature tables (see README).
time_zone: Asia/Kolkata (+05:30); all times are stored as ISO 8601 with an explicit offset

fields.name: warning_id
fields.description: Identifier as given in the advisory.

fields.name: warning_type
fields.description: Mapped from the advisory phrase by an explicit keyword table. Unknown, negated and multi-hazard phrases map to `other`, never guessed (a cyclone phrase also naming strong winds stays `cyclone`).

fields.name: warning_phrase
fields.description: Hazard phrase exactly as written in the advisory. Kept so that `other` (unknown, negated or multi-hazard phrases) loses no information.

fields.name: districts
fields.description: Districts exactly as written in the advisory.

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: End of validity. Must be after valid_from. Never defaulted when missing.

fields.name: source_kind
fields.description: `synthetic_sample` for test data, `imd_advisory` for real advisories.
